chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 404: The Shocking Truth of the Great Qi vs Great Liang War
chapter_meta_description: Zhuge Yuan drops a reality-shattering truth bomb: the Great Liang is a lie, and the Great Qi has always been real. Li Huowang faces the core philosophical paradox of the Dao-Twisted World.
og_title: The Great Qi Has Always Been Here – Zhuge Yuan’s Revelation Changes Everything
og_description: In Chapter 404, Li Huowang learns that the entire world might be a false script. Zhuge Yuan reveals the terrifying mechanics of the Heart-Pivot and the war between True and False cultivation.
twitter_title: The Great Liang is a lie? Zhuge Yuan’s philosophical nuke drops in Chapter 404.
twitter_description: Li Huowang debates the very nature of reality with Zhuge Yuan in this lore-heavy chapter. The Great Qi vs Great Liang debate is the key to the Dao-Twisted World’s deepest secret.

lore_anchors.definition: A Daoist alchemical pill that replaces meals and reduces bodily waste; used by travelers and cultivators to sustain themselves on long journeys without eating.

An entity around whom reality itself warps, creating contradictory but coexisting “correct” perceptions of the world; Zhuge Yuan is one, and his condition is tied to a power called “Above the Three Bodies.”
The corrupted counterpart to the Heart-Element; its power is to hide or erase concepts, objects, and memories from reality, rather than making fictions real.
The “true” dynasty that Zhuge Yuan perceives as real; in his eyes, everything and everyone belongs to the Great Qi, and the Great Liang is a false overlay.
The dynasty that Li Huowang and most others perceive as real; Zhuge Yuan insists it is a false construct that must be corrected.
A mysterious entity or principle that influences the Heart-Pivot’s reality-warping ability; its domain and nature are unknown, but it is distinct from other Simings like Bashe or the decay-nun.
A young follower of the Ao-Jing Sect who adores Li Huowang for having completed the Dung-Beetle Ascension three times; his presence signals that Li Huowang’s reputation in the sect is growing.
